--alias.help: set model name aliases, comma-separated (to be used by API)

--api-key.help: API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list (default: none)

--api-key-file.help: path to file containing API keys, one per line; lines starting with a hash are treated as comments (default: none)

--binary-file.help: binary file containing the prompt (default: none)

--cache-list.help: show list of models in cache

--chat-template-kwargs.help: sets additional params for the json template parser, must be a valid json object string, e.g. '{\"key1\":\"value1\",\"key2\":\"value2\"}'

--cls-separator.help: separator of classification sequences (default \\t) for example \"<#seq#>\"

--color.help: Colorize output to distinguish prompt and user input from generations ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto')\n

--completion-bash.help: print source-able bash completion script for llama.cpp

--context-file.help: file to load context from (use comma-separated values to specify multiple files)

--control-vector.help: add a control vector\nnote: use comma-separated values to add multiple control vectors

--cpu-mask.help: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range (default: \"\")

--cpu-mask-batch.help: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range-batch (default: same as --cpu-mask)

--cpu-moe.help: keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU

--cpu-strict-batch.help: use strict CPU placement (default: same as --cpu-strict)

--dflash.help: also download the DFlash sidecar, if available (default: unused)

--draft.help: the argument has been removed. use --spec-draft-n-max or --spec-ngram-mod-n-max

--draft-min.help: the argument has been removed. use --spec-draft-n-min or --spec-ngram-mod-n-min

--eagle3.help: also download the Eagle3 sidecar, if available (default: unused)

--embd-output-format.help: empty = default, \"array\" = [[],[]...], \"json\" = openai style, \"json+\" = same \"json\" + cosine similarity matrix, \"raw\" = plain whitespace-delimited output (one embedding per line)

--file.help: a file containing the prompt (default: none)

--grammar.help: BNF-like grammar to constrain generations (see samples in grammars/ dir)

--hellaswag.help: compute HellaSwag score over random tasks from datafile supplied with -f

--hf-file.help: Hugging Face model file. If specified, it will override the quant in --hf-repo (default: unused)

--hf-token.help: Hugging Face access token (default: value from HF_TOKEN environment variable)

--ignore-eos.help: ignore end of stream token and continue generating (implies --logit-bias EOS-inf)

--image.help: path to an image, audio, or video file. use with multimodal models, use comma-separated values for multiple files\n

--image-max-tokens.help: maximum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution (default: read from model)

--image-min-tokens.help: minimum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution (default: read from model)

--in-file.help: an input file (use comma-separated values to specify multiple files)

--in-prefix.help: string to prefix user inputs with (default: empty)

--in-prefix-bos.help: prefix BOS to user inputs, preceding the `--in-prefix` string

--in-suffix.help: string to suffix after user inputs with (default: empty)

--json-schema.help: JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{\"type\": \"object\"}` for any JSON object

--json-schema-file.help: File containing a JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{\"type\": \"object\"}` for any JSON object

--kl-divergence.help: computes KL-divergence to logits provided via --kl-divergence-base

--kv-unified-per-slot.help: context limit per parallel slot (default: unset, behavior unchanged).\n

--lazy-mode.help: on-demand reading of certain tensors, for example per-layer embeddings (default: auto)\n

--list-devices.help: print list of available devices and exit

--log-prompts-dir.help: Log prompts to directory (auto-created if not present; only used for debugging, default: disabled)

--logit-bias.help: modifies the likelihood of token appearing in the completion,\n

--lookup-cache-dynamic.help: path to dynamic lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (updated by generation)

--lookup-cache-static.help: path to static lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (not updated by generation)

--lora.help: path to LoRA adapter (use comma-separated values to load multiple adapters)

--mcp-servers-config.help: experimental: path to JSON file with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none)\n

--mcp-servers-json.help: experimental: inline JSON with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none)\n

--media-path.help: directory for loading local media files; files can be accessed via file:// URLs using relative paths (default: disabled)

--mmproj.help: path to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md\n

--mmproj-device.help: device to use for multimodal projector (none = don't offload, default: follows --device)\n

--mmproj-url.help: URL to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md

--models-dir.help: directory containing models for the router server (default: disabled)

--models-preset.help: path to INI file containing model presets for the router server (default: disabled)

--mtp.help: also download the multi-token prediction (MTP) head, if available (default: unused)

--multiline-input.help: allows you to write or paste multiple lines without ending each in '\\'

--multiple-choice.help: compute multiple choice score over random tasks from datafile supplied with -f

--n-cpu-ffn.help: keep the dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU\n

--n-cpu-moe.help: keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU

--no-agent.help: whether to enable CORS proxy and all built-in tools - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled)\n

--no-cache-idle-slots.help: save idle slots to the prompt cache on new task, and clear them when using unified KV (default: enabled, requires cache-ram)

--no-conversation.help: whether to run in conversation mode:\n

--no-host.help: bypass host buffer allowing extra buffers to be used

--no-kv-unified.help: use single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences (default: enabled if number of slots is auto)

--no-log-jsonl.help: Log as JSONL (one JSON object per line) to stdout, this also disables colored logging (default: disabled)

--no-reasoning-preserve.help: preserve reasoning trace in the full history, not just the last assistant message (default: enabled)\n

--no-ui-mcp-proxy.help: experimental: whether to enable MCP CORS proxy - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled)

--numa.help: attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems\n

--offline.help: Offline mode: forces use of cache, prevents network access

--poll-batch.help: use polling to wait for work (default: same as --poll)

--prompt.help: prompt to start generation with; for system message, use -sys

--prompt-cache.help: file to cache prompt state for faster startup (default: none)

--prompt-cache-all.help: if specified, saves user input and generations to cache as well\n

--prompt-cache-ro.help: if specified, uses the prompt cache but does not update it

--reasoning.help: Use reasoning/thinking in the chat ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto' (detect from template))

--reasoning-budget.help: token budget for thinking: -1 for unrestricted, 0 for immediate end, N>0 for token budget (default: -1)

--reasoning-budget-message.help: message injected before the end-of-thinking tag when reasoning budget is exhausted (default: none)

--reasoning-effort.help: reasoning effort level given to the chat template: 'default' to keep the template default,\n

--reasoning-format.help: controls whether thought tags are allowed and/or extracted from the response, and in which format they're returned; one of:\n

--reverse-prompt.help: halt generation at PROMPT, return control in interactive mode\n

--rope-freq-base.help: RoPE base frequency, used by NTK-aware scaling (default: loaded from model)

--rope-freq-scale.help: RoPE frequency scaling factor, expands context by a factor of 1/N

--rope-scale.help: RoPE context scaling factor, expands context by a factor of N

--simple-io.help: use basic IO for better compatibility in subprocesses and limited consoles

--single-turn.help: run conversation for a single turn only, then exit when done\n

--slot-save-path.help: path to save slot kv cache (default: disabled)

--spec-draft-cpu-mask.help: Draft model CPU affinity mask. Complements cpu-range-draft (default: same as --cpu-mask)

--spec-draft-cpu-mask-batch.help: Draft model CPU affinity mask. Complements cpu-range-draft (default: same as --cpu-mask)

--spec-draft-cpu-moe.help: keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU for the draft model

--spec-draft-cpu-strict.help: Use strict CPU placement for draft model (default: same as --cpu-strict)

--spec-draft-cpu-strict-batch.help: Use strict CPU placement for draft model (default: --cpu-strict-draft)

--spec-draft-model.help: draft model for speculative decoding (default: unused)

--spec-draft-n-cpu-moe.help: keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU for the draft model

--spec-draft-poll.help: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: same as --poll)

--spec-draft-poll-batch.help: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: --poll-draft)

--spec-draft-threads.help: number of threads to use during generation (default: same as --threads)

--spec-draft-threads-batch.help: number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads-draft)

--spec-ngram-min-hits.help: the argument has been removed. use the respective --spec-ngram-*-min-hits

--spec-ngram-size-m.help: the argument has been removed. use the respective --spec-ngram-*-size-m

--spec-ngram-size-n.help: the argument has been removed. use the respective --spec-ngram-*-size-n or --spec-ngram-mod-n-match

--spec-synth-len.help: target mean synthetic acceptance length, including the target token (benchmarking only)

--spec-synth-rates.help: comma-separated unconditional per-position synthetic acceptance probabilities (benchmarking only)

--ssl-cert-file.help: path to file a PEM-encoded SSL certificate

--ssl-key-file.help: path to file a PEM-encoded SSL private key

--system-prompt.help: system prompt to use with model (if applicable, depending on chat template)

--system-prompt-file.help: a file containing the system prompt (default: none)

--tags.help: set model tags, comma-separated (informational, not used for routing)

--tensor-filter.help: filter tensor names for debug output (regex pattern, can be specified multiple times)

--tensor-split.help: fraction of the model to offload to each GPU, comma-separated list of proportions, e.g. 3,1

--threads-batch.help: number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads)

--tools.help: experimental: whether to enable built-in tools for AI agents - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: no tools)\n

--tools-runtime.help: experimental: run tools in a separate runtime environment (default: none, use host environment)\n

--tts-speaker-file.help: speaker file path for audio generation

--ui-config.help: JSON that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

--ui-config-file.help: JSON file that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

--verbose.help: Set verbosity level to infinity (i.e. log all messages, useful for debugging)

--video-ffmpeg-dir.help: path to the directory containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (default: search in PATH)

--winogrande.help: compute Winogrande score over random tasks from datafile supplied with -f
